# Coding Assignment

This folder documents the methodological mapping of specific registry codes to clinical quality indicators within the AFDK 2025 framework. It currently holds a single detailed record explaining how the BFKB intervention code is explicitly assigned as the numerator for calculating Indikator 8. Because the source corpus limits its discussion of coding assignments to this specific definitional parameter, the folder serves as a precise reference for this isolated data mapping rather than a broad catalog of indicator methodologies.

## Pages

- [[coding-assignment|Coding Assignment]] — Details the specific methodological mapping where the BFKB code serves as the numerator for Indikator 8, based on the AFDK 2025 documentation.
